'''Undercity Junction 353''' was a power junction located in the [[Old World|Undercity]] of [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 10" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] wired an [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] into the Junction and later detonated it to disable the [[Overwatch]] security.<ref name="KotFE 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Power Junction 353 appears as an area on Zakuul during "Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 10" />
